reason: A Windows Electron desktop wrapper for dsh that embeds its web interface and adds side panels for usage, skills, plugins, tools, and session controls; it also manages local configuration and automatic updates.

summaries.zh: 一个将 dsh Web 界面封装为 Windows Electron 桌面应用并提供技能、插件及会话控制面板的工具。
summaries.en: A Windows Electron desktop wrapper for dsh that embeds its web interface and provides panels for managing skills, plugins, tools, and sessions.

capabilities: Launches a local dsh web process inside an Electron window
Reads and writes dsh configuration, skill, plugin, and session statistics under ~/.dsh
Checks npm for updates and installs the latest dsh package before restarting
May request administrator approval to enable Windows Developer Mode
